outcome: Apoptotic cells (cleaved PARP, TUNEL positive cells)
cohort: The study included 12 patients who had a history of myelomeningocele repair surgery after birth and subsequently developed secondary tethered cord syndrome.
finding: The study identified astrocytosis, presence of monocytes, activated microglia, apoptotic cells, and elevated levels of pro-inflammatory (IL-1ss, TNF-a) and hypoxia-related (HIF-1a/-2a) mediators in secondary tethered cord syndrome specimens, suggesting their role in disease development.
